title: Medichain.ai
tagline: FHIR-based Web3 healthcare with AI-driven, patient-owned records & family risk analysis
description:
MediChain.AI is a Web3-powered, AI-driven healthcare platform where patients truly own and control their medical records. By combining blockchain, AI, and decentralized storage, it ensures transparency, immutability, and patient-controlled access.

Blockchain Layer (Polygon): Stores metadata and consent logs for secure, verifiable access.

Off-Chain Storage: Encrypted health records stored in IPFS/Filecoin + MongoDB.

AI Engine: Provides prescription interpretation, medication summaries, and genetic risk detection across generations.
Family Health Graph: Enables intergenerational linkage of health data to identify hereditary risks.

FHIR Format (WHO Standard): Ensures interoperability across hospitals, labs, and digital platforms worldwide.
how_its_made:
We built MediChain.AI with a layered architecture combining Web3, AI, and decentralized storage:

Frontend: Browser-based interface for patients/doctors, wallet integration (MetaMask Snap).

Backend: Node.js + Express server managing off-chain storage, authentication, and AI service orchestration.

Blockchain (Polygon): For consent logs, metadata storage, and immutable access trails.

Storage: IPFS/Filecoin for encrypted records, MongoDB for fast indexing and retrieval.

AI Engine: Python microservices that summarize medical reports and perform genetic risk analysis.
Notifications: Real-time alerts for record access requests and approvals.

User Onbaording: Using Self protocol via Aadhar based authentication for Authenticity.

Graph Optimization: Integrated The Graph for efficient data queries and visualization of family health linkage.
